details: Bitcoin's price has fallen below $76,000, trading around $75,866, marking a 2.4% decrease in the past 24 hours. This decline is attributed to a broader risk-off sentiment in global markets, driven by concerns over inflation, anticipated interest rate hikes, and ongoing geopolitical tensions. Bitcoin, increasingly correlated with tech stocks and traditional markets, is also experiencing selling pressure from long-term holders.
title: Bitcoin Drops Amid Global Risk-Off Sentiment and Rate Hike Fears

details: A study by the Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland indicates that exposure to Bitcoin's past returns encourages individuals to purchase more cryptocurrency. The research also found that crypto holders, typically younger males optimistic about returns, perceive crypto as safer. Furthermore, Bitcoin price fluctuations influence holders' spending on durable goods, with increases in price leading to more spending and decreases leading to cutbacks.
title: Federal Reserve Study Links Bitcoin Gains to Increased Crypto Buying and Consumer Spending

details: In the last 24 hours, global cryptocurrency liquidations reached $995 million. Long positions accounted for $721 million of these liquidations, while short positions made up $274 million, impacting approximately 214,000 users worldwide. This significant liquidation event highlights heightened volatility in the crypto markets.
title: Nearly $1 Billion in Crypto Liquidated in Past 24 Hours

details: XRP saw a notable flash crash, with its price dropping approximately 37% in minutes, losing about $0.60, leading to the liquidation of around $500 million in XRP leveraged long positions across major derivatives platforms. This event was part of a broader liquidation wave totaling $1.35 billion in crypto positions over 24 hours. Analysts suggest the crash was primarily driven by the liquidation of excessively leveraged long positions rather than new fundamental shocks.
title: XRP Experiences Flash Crash and Significant Volatility

details: As of August 24, 2026, the global cryptocurrency market capitalization rose by 0.9% to $2.7 trillion in the last 24 hours, with total trading volume at $87.2 billion. Bitcoin's dominance stands at 56.6%, while Ethereum holds 9.82% and saw a 1.2% rise in its price. Sentiment is generally described as "Greed" reaching 73, indicating strong investor interest.
title: Overall Crypto Market Sees Slight Rise, Ethereum Gains, Bitcoin Stable
